integrity: The proof uses the support-functional characterization of Birkhoff orthogonality and an exact dihedral reduction to one facet--vertex family. On that family the two relevant norms are affine in the edge parameter, so the objective is exactly affine and its endpoint maximum is symbolic. The bundled checker verifies the facet incidence, active-facet inequalities, trigonometric identities, and radical simplification. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the affine-regular decagonal Banach plane. It does not provide a formula for all regular Radon polygons and it does not classify every maximizing Birkhoff-orthogonal pair.
title: Exact \(C_B\) constant of the affine-regular decagonal Banach plane
